rv.q: Company XIV’s Queen of Hearts is a rabbit hole worth taking a few subways to visit.
Queen of Hearts is the best date-night show in New York City right now.
From the lithe performers, who all seem to hold master's degrees in writhing, to the sybaritic atmosphere, pleasure is the goal. It's irresistible.

cn.t: Austin McCormick's lavish, adults-only reimagining of Alice in Wonderland dazzles critics with its extravagant excess and bawdy Belle Époque spectacle, delivering eclectic thrills in Company XIV's Bushwick home.
